checks.description: RDS instances must have storage encryption enabled to protect data at rest
checks.impact: Unencrypted RDS storage exposes sensitive data if the underlying EBS volumes are accessed directly or if a snapshot is shared or restored outside the account
checks.resolution: Set storage_encrypted = true on the aws_db_instance resource. Note: encryption cannot be enabled on an existing unencrypted instance — a snapshot restore to a new encrypted instance is required
checks.errorMessage: RDS instance does not have storage encryption enabled (storage_encrypted must be true)
